name: Turn2 Specialty Companies

hero.title: Proven people. Proven results.
hero.lead: Turn2 Specialty Companies is an industrial contractor in Baytown, Texas, providing specialty turnaround services to the refining, petrochemical and power industries. The company is ASME and NBIC certified.
hero.titleAccent: Specialty turnaround work for refineries and plants.

highlights.title: ASME & NBIC certified
highlights.text: The company holds ASME and NBIC certification, and all its welders are ASME certified.

highlights.title: 250+ years combined on towers and drums
highlights.text: The leadership team has over 250 years of combined tower and drum experience.

highlights.title: Emergency tower work
highlights.text: Emergency tower work is part of what Turn2 offers.

highlights.title: Long-tenure crews
highlights.text: Tower crews are long-tenure employees with many years of experience working together.

summary: Turn2 in Baytown, TX, handles tower and drum services, specialty welding and catalyst handling for refining, petrochemical and power.

about.title: From helper to welder to president
text: Turn2 Specialty Companies was formed to provide specialty turnaround services to the refining, petrochemical and power industries.

President Joe Vardell worked his way up from helper to welder to president, and has more than 40 years in refining, chemical, fertilizer and power. Joe Vardell, our president, believes integrity and transparency are the keys to successful partnerships.

The company's motto, "Proven People. Proven Results.", is also its core value, and it counts its people as its most important asset. Quality and safety are fundamental, and every employee, supplier and customer is part of the process.
